name: comp-269
title: Error Inline Alert
description: An inline error strip for forms: a rounded border around a small red circled exclamation and the words An error occurred. It never floats and has no close button.
use: A form needs a short, permanent error line next to the fields that caused it.
avoid: The message and its wording are fixed in the file, so varied or dismissible errors need editing.
a11y: The icon is hidden from assistive tech, but the strip has no alert role, so an error appearing later is not announced. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Inside a dark sign-in card sits a full-width rounded rectangle with a thin border, holding a small ringed red exclamation mark and a short line of pale text. Below are an email row, a password row with a red edge, and a white button.
behaves: Static: nothing moves or responds. The strip stays in place above the fields and cannot be dismissed.
customise: Only the border, padding and text classes are adjustable; the message itself is written into the file and there are no props.
weight: light: A border, a 16px icon and one line of text.
